sources.title: Groundwater logger monitoring points
sources.notes: Groundwater depth-logger positions + peil/polder context. The service returns these points with NULL geometry — coordinates live in XCOORDINAAT/YCOORDINAAT (attributeGeometryOnly), so the PoC fetches them attribute-mode (gwt/sensors.fetch_layer_attrs) instead of poc.pipeline.geodata, which drops null geometries. Time series are NOT in this layer (LIZARDID present for Lizard, auth-gated); series live in the growing local archive.

sources.title: Rain-gauge locations (context)
sources.notes: Rijnland rain gauges; positions only in the open layer. Daily precipitation values come from open-meteo (keyless).

sources.title: Daily precipitation (archive + forecast)
sources.notes: Keyless REST (verified 2026-10-13). ERA5-derived daily sums; forecast daily sums. Area mean over a 3x3 grid on the AOI. Thesis equivalent: KNMI RH(mm) join.

sources.title: Growing groundwater-depth archive
sources.notes: Per-logger daily depth series. SEEDED deterministically from open metadata + measured rain (syntheticSeed=true) because BRO api.bro-data.nl and Rijnland Lizard are credential/DNS-gated (recon 2026-10-13). scripts/fetch_gwt hook documents the real-series merge; same growing-archive pattern as PoC-3 fase 2d.
